coreMemory.english: n. physical or mental energy used to do something
coreMemory.structure: make an effort /meɪk æn ˈefərt/（付出努力）；put effort into /pʊt ˈefərt ɪntu/（投入精力）；a great deal of effort /ə ɡreɪt dil ʌv ˈefərt/（大量努力）；with little effort /wɪð lɪtəl ˈefərt/（不费什么力）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use effort with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of effort in context；❌ translate effort word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “make an effort”

commonErrors.wrong: use effort with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈefərt wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of effort in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈefərt ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “make an effort”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz meɪk æn ˈefərt/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
